entities.summary: Mustafa Demir was a Turkish architect and politician who was the Mayor of the Samsun Metropolitan Municipality. Prior to his becoming mayor, he was the Samsun Deputy in the 22nd, 23rd and 24th legislative terms and served as the Minister of Public Works and Housing. He was the founder and chairman of the Samsun Province charter of the ruling AK Party.
